name: @serika/desktop
description: Serika desktop front end. Consumes createRuntimeApp from the CLI package; contains no runtime logic.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/test-home.mjs --home "$SERIKA_TEST_HOME" -- /bin/sh -c 'tsx --test --test-concurrency=4 src/shared/*.test.ts src/main/*.test.ts src/renderer/src/*.test.ts src/renderer/src/personal/*.test.ts && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs'
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.smoke: node ../../scripts/test-home.mjs --home "$SERIKA_TEST_HOME" -- /bin/sh -c 'pnpm --workspace-root build:runtime && pnpm build && node scripts/electron-smoke-fixture.mjs'
